name: dsh-connector-shared
//: A library, not a DSH plugin (R-ARCH-08, design §9.1): no `dsh` field, so no bundle, row, client or service, and it never appears on a Plugins page. It is the DSH side's library (requirements 1.40, design §1.0b row 5): it holds only modules at least two DSH-side packages import (R-ARCH-08 strict, Fishball's decision 2026-11-17), imports no other V3 package, and ships inside their tarballs through bundleDependencies (V3 publishes nothing to a registry). ./redact is the connector's and the instance's, ./request-host embed-UI's and the instance's. C-WIRE-2 moved the single-user modules into their one user: files and provider-sync* into dsh-instance (src/lib/), oauth-client into dsh-connector-adapter (src/). The Fishball side has its own library, fishball-shared; no module is shared across the sides.
description: Modules at least two DSH-side packages use: the secret-shape redaction and the request-hostname rule.
